video.title: AI欧腐《爱上死对头/Falling For My Rival》
video.desc:
Alex Reed, a fiercely competitive Alpha boxing champion, is preparing for the World Championships when team doctor Damon Carter discovers a serious old injury and orders him to stop competing. Forced to live and train together during Alex's rehabilitation, the two rivals clash constantly, but their hostility gradually turns into attraction. What Alex does not know is that Damon is secretly an Omega—and Gus, the legendary boxing champion Alex has spent ten years searching for. As hidden identities, jealousy, doping schemes, and career-threatening scandals come to light, Alex must choose between proving himself in the ring and protecting the man he has fallen for. Their relationship is pushed to the limit when Damon’s identity is publicly exposed just before the championship final, forcing both men to confront their past, their ambitions, and what they truly mean to each other.

Alex Reed 是一位好胜心极强的 Alpha 拳击冠军。备战世锦赛期间，队医 Damon Carter 发现他有一处严重的旧伤，勒令他停止比赛。康复期间，两人被迫同吃同住、一起训练，针锋相对、冲突不断，敌意却渐渐变成了吸引。
Alex 不知道的是，Damon 其实是一个隐藏身份的 Omega——更是 Gus，那个他寻找了十年的传奇拳王。
随着隐藏的身份、嫉妒、禁药阴谋和足以毁掉职业生涯的丑闻一一浮出水面，Alex 必须在"在拳台上证明自己"和"保护自己爱上的人"之间做出抉择。决赛前夕，Damon 的身份被公之于众，两人的关系被推向极限——他们不得不直面彼此的过去、各自的野心，以及对方在自己心中究竟意味着什么。
